description.en: A public storefront website for a small cross-border seller: it shows the products from Busa Product Hub, takes order requests into an Orders table, and comes with a daily shop check your agent runs and improves from your feedback.
description.zh-CN: 面向小型跨境卖家的公开独立站：直接展示 Busa 产品枢纽里的商品，把买家的订单请求写进订单表，并附带一个每日店铺巡检，由你的智能体执行、按你的反馈持续改进。

agentPrompts: Import this product list into the product hub (Excel with pictures, or CSV with photos and certificates). Show me the preview first.
Open my shop: check that the website can read my Busa Product Hub products and the shop settings, and tell me what I still have to do before I click Go live.
Run today's shop check: read my feedback on the last report, then check products, certificates, new orders and the live site, and write one report.
Handle the new orders on my shop: check items and stock, and draft a confirmation reply for each one for me to send.
